title: Canada to boost spending by C$142B over five years
summary:
Increased Canadian government spending may lead to cautious monetary policy adjustments, impacting interest rates and economic stability.
The post Canada to boost spending by C$142B over five years appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Canada plans to significantly increase government spending by C$142 billion over the next five years. This major fiscal expansion could prompt cautious monetary policy adjustments, potentially influencing interest rates and broader economic stability in the country.
content_ta: அடுத்த ஐந்து ஆண்டுகளில் அரசின் செலவினங்களை C$142 பில்லியன் அளவுக்கு கணிசமாக அதிகரிக்க Canada திட்டமிட்டுள்ளது. இந்த முக்கிய நிதி விரிவாக்கம் எச்சரிக்கையான பணவியல் கொள்கை மாற்றங்களைத் தூண்டக்கூடும், இது நாட்டில் வட்டி விகிதங்களையும் பொருளாதார ஸ்திரத்தன்மையையும் பாதிக்கக்கூடும்.

title: Gate Pioneers Proof of Security (PoSEC), Achieving 104.58% Cold Storage Coverage to Solidify Asset Security
summary: Gate has officially introduced Proof of Security (PoSEC), a new asset security verification framework, becoming the first digital asset trading platform in the industry to launch a PoSEC security verification system. Since its founding in 2013, Gate has consistently placed user asset security at the forefront of its priorities. With the introduction of PoSEC, Gate extends security verification beyond reserve adequacy to include asset storage structures and risk coverage capabilities, further solidifying safeguards for user assets and providing a new practical approach to advancing industry security standards. PoSEC Focuses on Asset Storage Security and Quantifies Extreme-Risk Coverage Capabilities Unlike Proof of Reserves (PoR), which primarily verifies the adequacy of asset reserves, PoSEC places additional emphasis on asset storage security. By publicly disclosing the distribution of assets between platform cold storage and hot wallets, PoSEC provides visibility into asset storage structures and their ability to cover potential losses under extreme scenarios. PoSEC introduces the cold storage coverage ratio as a key metric to measure the extent to which cold storage covers total user assets. A coverage ratio ≥ 100% means that, under the applicable calculation methodology, cold storage alone would be sufficient to cover all user assets even if all assets held in hot wallets were lost. PoR and PoSEC serve complementary purposes, extending asset security verification from reserve adequacy to storage security and risk coverage, while providing users with more comprehensive and transparent information about asset security. Cold Storage Coverage Reaches 104.58%, with Open and Transparent Storage Structure According to the snapshot taken at 00:00 (UTC) on November 4, 2026, Gate’s cold storage coverage ratio reached 104.58%, with cold storage and hot wallet assets accounting for 88.26% and 11.74% of total assets, respectively. Cold storage assets include digital assets held offline and traditional assets under independent custody. To qualify, these assets must meet requirements such as not being directly used for routine deposits and withdrawals, being held offline or under independent custody, requiring multi-party authorization for transfers, and being independently verifiable. The current data is undergoing verification by an independent third-party audit firm. The review covers asset authenticity and control, valuation and calculation methodologies, and coverage ratio calculations. The audit report will be published on Gate’s official website upon completion, enhancing the transparency and credibility of asset security disclosures. From PoR to PoSEC: Continuously Strengthening Digital Asset Security Gate has long been committed to digital asset security and transparency. In 2020, Gate was among the first in the industry to introduce an open-source Proof of Reserves (PoR) mechanism and a Merkle Tree-based asset verification solution, establishing itself as an early contributor to reserve transparency in the industry. Gate subsequently incorporated technologies such as zk-SNARKs to enhance its asset reserve verification framework. As of October 18, 2026, Gate’s total reserves amounted to approximately $8.688 billion, with an overall reserve ratio of 118.49%. The platform also employs a range of security mechanisms, including hot and cold wallet segregation, multi-signature technology, Multi-Party Computation (MPC), dynamic risk monitoring, and zero-trust access control, to establish a multi-layered security framework covering asset reserves, storage management, and risk protection. From PoR, which verifies reserve adequacy, to PoSEC, which verifies asset storage security and risk coverage capabilities, Gate is progressively building a multi-layered security framework encompassing asset reserves, storage management, risk protection, and public verification. Looking ahead, Gate will continue to uphold its security-first principle, further develop PoSEC standards and verification mechanisms, and collaborate with more industry participants to enhance asset security and transparency, laying a stronger security foundation for the long-term, sustainable development of the digital asset industry.   Learn more: https://www.gate.com/proof-of-security About Gate Gate, founded in 2013 by Dr. Han, is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency and integrated financial services platforms, spanning financial and everyday use cases including asset management, trading and payments. Serving over 62 million users globally, it supports trading across 5,400+ digital assets and 12,800+ stock assets and ETFs, while providing access to a comprehensive range of TradFi assets, including metals, stocks, indices, forex, and commodities to meet users’ end-to-end needs across asset holding, trading, and spending. As an industry benchmark, Gate was among the first platforms to implement 100% Proof of Reserves. Its ecosystem includes Gate Money, Gate Wallet, Gate Ventures, Gate for AI Agent, and a wide range of products and services.   For more information, please visit: Website | X | Telegram | LinkedIn| Instagram | YouTube   Disclaimer: This content does not constitute an offer, solicitation, or recommendation. You should always seek independent professional advice before making investment decisions. Note that Gate may restrict or prohibit certain services in specific jurisdictions. For more information, please read the User Agreement.
content: Gate has officially introduced Proof of Security (PoSEC), a new asset security verification framework. Becoming the first digital asset trading platform to launch such a system, Gate achieved a cold storage coverage ratio of 104.58%. The framework extends verification beyond reserve adequacy to include asset storage structures and extreme-risk coverage capabilities, reinforcing asset security and industry standards.
content_ta: Gate நிறுவனம் Proof of Security (PoSEC) எனப்படும் புதிய சொத்து பாதுகாப்பு சரிபார்ப்பு முறையை அதிகாரப்பூர்வமாக அறிமுகப்படுத்தியுள்ளது. இத்தகைய அமைப்பைத் தொடங்கிய முதல் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து வர்த்தக தளமான Gate, 104.58% கோல்டு ஸ்டோரேஜ் கவரேஜ் விகிதத்தை எட்டியுள்ளது. இந்த கட்டமைப்பு, இருப்பு adequacy-ஐ தாண்டி சொத்து சேமிப்பு கட்டமைப்புகள் மற்றும் தீவிர-ஆபத்து கவரேஜ் திறன்களை உள்ளடக்கியது, இது பயனர் சொத்து பாதுகாப்பை மேலும் பலப்படுத்துகிறது.

title: Canada sets 380,000 annual immigration target, renews monetary policy framework
summary:
Canada's economic strategy continuity may stabilize markets, but potential rate hikes hinge on inflation data and global oil price shifts.
The post Canada sets 380,000 annual immigration target, renews monetary policy framework appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Canada has announced a target of 380,000 annual immigrants and renewed its monetary policy framework. This economic continuity aims to help stabilize markets. However, potential interest rate hikes will depend on upcoming inflation data and fluctuations in global oil prices.
content_ta: கனடா ஆண்டுதோறும் 380,000 குடியேற்றங்களை இலக்காக நிர்ணயித்துள்ளதாகவும், தனது நாணயக் கொள்கை கட்டமைப்பைப் புதுப்பித்துள்ளதாகவும் அறிவித்துள்ளது. இந்த பொருளாதார தொடர்ச்சியானது சந்தைகளை நிலைநிறுத்த உதவும். இருப்பினும், சாத்தியமான வட்டி விகித உயர்வு என்பது பணவீக்க தரவுகள் மற்றும் உலகளாவிய கச்சா எண்ணெய் விலை மாற்றங்களைப் பொறுத்தது.

title: Canada to borrow C$611B in 2027/28, 72% for refinancing maturing debt
summary:
Canada's increased borrowing for debt refinancing may limit the Bank of Canada's rate hike options, impacting future fiscal strategies.
The post Canada to borrow C$611B in 2027/28, 72% for refinancing maturing debt appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Canada announced plans to borrow C$611 billion in the 2027/28 fiscal year, with 72% of this amount dedicated to refinancing maturing debt. This significant increase in borrowing requirements could potentially limit the Bank of Canada's options regarding future interest rate hikes, ultimately shaping the nation's broader fiscal and monetary strategies moving forward.
content_ta: 2027/28 நிதியாண்டில் C$611 பில்லியன் கடனாகப் பெற உள்ளதாக Canada அறிவித்துள்ளது. இதில் 72% முதிர்வடையும் கடன்களைத் திரும்பச் செலுத்தப் பயன்படுத்தப்பட உள்ளது. கடனுக்கான இந்த அதிகரித்த தேவை Bank of Canada-வின் எதிர்கால வட்டி விகித உயர்வுகளுக்கான வாய்ப்புகளைக் கட்டுப்படுத்தக்கூடும்.

title: Canada projects C$62B deficit for 2026-27 amid supply disruptions
summary:

content: Canada has projected a significant budget deficit of C$62 billion for the 2026-27 fiscal year, driven largely by ongoing supply disruptions. title: Khosla: AI and quantum computers to break encryption by 2030
summary:
The potential for AI and quantum computing to break encryption by 2030 could destabilize digital security, urging swift cryptographic advancements.
The post Khosla: AI and quantum computers to break encryption by 2030 appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Tech venture capitalist Vinod Khosla warns that artificial intelligence and quantum computers could break current encryption methods by the year 2030. This potential technological advancement poses a significant risk to global digital security, highlighting an urgent need for the development of advanced cryptographic solutions to protect sensitive data before these threats materialize.
